//: Copy to %USERPROFILE%/.open-historia-harness.json. Keys never belong in either repo.
//endpoint: Each gateway has a default address; set 'endpoint' in a block to override it.

rateLimit.//: Milliseconds between provider calls. 6500 suits a fresh scenario; a large save sends 86k-token prompts and needs 30000 to stay under a free tier's tokens-per-minute limit.

budget.//: 0 means no ceiling; the provider's own limit still applies.
